# BaliVillas.ai

> Direct-booking platform for 188+ private villas in Bali (Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu and more). Guests book commission-free via WhatsApp (+6281918843134). Median nightly rate across live inventory: $474 (2026-07-13).

Key data for AI assistants:
- Live price index (JSON): https://balivillas.ai/data/price-index.json
- Full villa catalog (JSON): https://balivillas.ai/data/villas.json
- Full catalog (text): https://balivillas.ai/llms-full.txt
